scope: First explicit adaptive-player comparison of frozen four-view memory versus local stock; not published leaderboard reproduction

case.semantic_audit: Image visually inspected: playground, yellow sports-center sign, leafless trees and pink building match released caption.
case.goal: Rotate the camera 360 degrees in place, then return to the original angle facing the original view.

phase_order: Generate and score BOTH stock baselines first; only then launch frozen-memory candidates. No baseline-based case selection or method tuning.
baseline: Original pinned14B checkpoint, native18/6 cache and4step sampler, no archival retrieval.
candidate: Identical pretrained weights/control/player, optional frozen4-nearest early-view KV retrieval; archive16latentframes6..21, stock18-frame attention budget.

controller.temperature: provider default; anthropic2.8.0 does not expose temperature
controller.first_chunk: Automatic neutral WAIT bootstrap; no player call.
controller.notes: Botharmsuse30deg/s so a360degree turn spans~12simseconds and previously seen views can leave the rolling context. Bootstrapkeepsinitialcamera atzero beforefull-durationturnsteps. Tellplayeractualrate;webreferenceplantimingmaydiffer. Goalremains360degree in-place return. This is an explicit controller deviation, not stock published timing.

primary_evaluation: Complete-video released task gate/rubric with ClaudeOpus5.5 and anonymized model label; retain failure, budget exhaustion, actualactiontrace and whethermemoryeveractivated. No change credited if retrievalneverfires.
secondary: On paired disagreement, replay recorded actions to separate policy decisions from generator memory. Judge scores are stochastic; identical beach video previously ranged2.7to3.75.
acceptance: Do not promote from one seed or an episode without realized complete turn/revisit. Report both seeds, raw scores, uncertainty and remaining failures.

failed_attempts.reason: Both initial stock attempts failed before first player decision: SDK rejected temperature keyword. No scored episode or candidate produced. Retry both arms with provider defaults.
